text:
### Identification Process  
**Step 1: Document Collection**
- Request primary document from customer
- Collect document ID, issue date, expiry date
- Assess document integrity (no tampering, alterations)  
**Step 2: Physical Verification**
- Examine original document in person (branch opening) or certified copy (postal)
- Verify photo matches customer appearance (if in-person)
- Check signature matches customer specimen
- Confirm document not expired  
**Step 3: System Recording**
- Record document type, number, issue/expiry dates in AMS (Account Management System)
- Link to [[business_ontology]] Identification Document entity
- Flag any concerns for manual review  
**Step 4: Verification Method by Channel**  
**Branch Opening (Highest Assurance):**
- Physical examination of original document
- Staff verify photo against customer
- Immediate verification in-person
- Record: "In-branch verified" + staff name + date  
**Online Opening (Medium Assurance):**
- Customer uploads certified copy (notarized)
- Automated document validation (if available)
- Manual review by Compliance staff
- Record: "Document-based verification" + reviewer name + date  
**Postal Opening (Lower Assurance):**
- Customer sends certified copy by registered mail
- Manual review by Compliance
- Cross-reference with address verification
- Follow-up verification call recommended
- Record: "Postal verification" + reviewer name + date

raw_entities.name: Customer Identification Process
raw_entities.description: A four-step customer identification procedure encompassing document collection, physical verification, system recording, and channel-specific verification methods. The process requires examination of primary identification documents, assessment of document integrity, photo matching, and signature verification, with different assurance levels applied based on the account opening channel (branch, online, or postal).
context: Examine original document in person (branch opening) or certified copy (postal)
Verify photo matches customer appearance (if in-person)
Record document type, number, issue/expiry dates in AMS (Account Management System)

raw_entities.name: Primary Identification Document
raw_entities.description: The main identity document collected from the customer during account opening, subject to integrity assessment, expiry verification, and recording in the Account Management System. The document must be examined for tampering or alterations and linked to the customer record.
context: Collect document ID, issue date, expiry date

raw_entities.name: Certified Copy
raw_entities.description: A notarized or certified copy of the primary identification document submitted by customers opening accounts online or via postal channels. Certified copies are subject to automated validation and manual review by Compliance staff.
context: Examine original document in person (branch opening) or certified copy (postal)
Customer sends certified copy by registered mail

raw_entities.name: Document Integrity Assessment
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring staff to assess identification documents for signs of tampering, alterations, or damage during the document collection phase. This assessment is performed as part of Step 1 of the identification process.
context: Examine original document in person (branch opening) or certified copy (postal)

raw_entities.name: Photo Matching Verification
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring staff to verify that the photograph on the identification document matches the customer's appearance during in-person branch opening. This verification is performed as part of Step 2 of the identification process.
context: Verify photo matches customer appearance (if in-person)

raw_entities.name: Signature Verification
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring staff to verify that the signature on the identification document matches the customer's specimen signature. This verification is performed as part of Step 2 of the identification process.

raw_entities.name: Document Expiry Verification
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring staff to confirm that the identification document has not expired before accepting it for KYC purposes. This verification is performed as part of Step 2 of the identification process.
context: Collect document ID, issue date, expiry date

raw_entities.name: Account Management System Recording
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring staff to record identification document details (type, number, issue and expiry dates) in the Account Management System and link the document to the customer's identification record. Any concerns identified during verification are flagged for manual review.
context: Record document type, number, issue/expiry dates in AMS (Account Management System)
Flag any concerns for manual review

raw_entities.name: Automated Document Validation
raw_entities.description: An optional automated control measure available for online account openings to validate certified copies of identification documents before manual review by Compliance staff.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Cross-Reference
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring staff to cross-reference the customer's address with the identification document during postal account opening verification. This is performed as part of the postal verification channel procedure.

raw_entities.name: Follow-Up Verification Call
raw_entities.description: A recommended control measure for postal account openings involving a follow-up verification call to the customer to confirm identity and address details. This provides additional assurance for lower-assurance postal opening channels.

raw_entities.name: Branch Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members responsible for conducting in-person identification verification during branch account openings. Their responsibilities include examining original documents, verifying photo matches, checking signatures, and recording verification details with their name and date.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members responsible for manual review of identification documents submitted through online and postal account opening channels. They conduct document validation, flag concerns for escalation, and record verification details with their name and date.

raw_entities.name: Branch Account Opening
raw_entities.description: An account opening conducted in person at a branch location, subject to the highest assurance identification verification procedures including physical examination of original documents and immediate in-person photo and signature verification.

raw_entities.name: Online Account Opening
raw_entities.description: An account opening conducted through an online channel, subject to medium assurance identification verification procedures including customer upload of certified copies and automated or manual document validation by Compliance staff.

raw_entities.name: Postal Account Opening
raw_entities.description: An account opening conducted via postal submission, subject to lower assurance identification verification procedures including manual review of certified copies, address cross-reference, and recommended follow-up verification calls.
context: Customer sends certified copy by registered mail
